violations.description: Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Nonfood contact surface of clean in place equipment was not cleaned properly. -Some crumb/debris at bottom shelf of stainless prep table. -3 door prep table has residue at front of doors and at handles with some crumb debris at interior bottom. -Dust/debris at top of shelf above 3 door prep table. -Minimal residue at oven handle. -Dust debris at (currently unused) soup station.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Pink/black debris at ice chute of public soda dispenser.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc. …) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Some residue build up at back kitchen floor edges and below dish pit area shelves.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Food contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in good repair or sound condition. -Staining/grooves at cutting board of drive through makeline.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. -Staff rinsed stirring spoon (used for meatballs) at hand sink faucet. -Corrected immediately.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc. …) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Ice/frost build up at wire shelves, floor and vent of walk in freezer. -Walk in cooler has odor and food spill/debris at floor below shelving. -High dust at grates above walk in coolers.
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Designed, constructed, installed, and maintained (2 pts deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (1 pt deducted)
